definitions.explanation: Products harvested from the sea, including fish, shellfish, seaweed, and other marine organisms. A somewhat formal term encompassing all ocean-derived food and materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海産物|かいさんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: Hokkaido is rich in marine products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な{海産物|かいさんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought fresh seafood at the market.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海産物|かいさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄|さか}えて→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: This region has prospered through its marine product processing industry.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal compound noun. In everyday conversation, ⟦{魚介類|ぎょかいるい}→魚介類：23435_gyokairui⟧ (seafood, fish and shellfish) or simply ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幸|さち}→幸：28345_sachi⟧ (bounty of the sea) are also used. {海産物|かいさんぶつ} is broader, encompassing seaweed and other non-fish/shellfish items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な{海産物|かいさんぶつ}: fresh marine products
- {海産物|かいさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: processing of marine products
- {海産物|かいさんぶつ}⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧: seafood market
